info.title: man
info.description: Cross-platform man page viewer with colour and hyperlinks. Renders groff man/mdoc pages natively — no groff installation required.

options.name: --no-pager
options.description: Disable pager; write directly to stdout

options.name: --path
options.description: Print the file path of the page instead of rendering it

options.name: --where
options.description: Print the file path of the page instead of rendering it (GNU compatibility alias for --path)

options.name: --manpath
options.description: Print the effective man page search path and exit

options.name: --describe
options.description:
Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
Exit Codes:
0    Page found and displayed
1    Page not found
2    Usage error (bad arguments)
125  Internal error (corrupt page or read failure)
